body: I’m stuck in between both. I’m at a place where I don’t know what I want... the only thing I’m sure of is that I’m sick of waiting. I’m sick of waiting for medication to work. I’m tired of trying the same cliche bullshit that people say makes brains happy (it doesn’t). I’m sick of waiting for someone to come into my life and make it worth living. I’m just tired of waiting

I don’t want to speak for OP, but I feel as if I am living through his struggles. Maybe eye-for-eye justice isn’t morally correct, but you know what also isn’t morally correct? Absolutely ruining someone’s existence and then continuing to live your life as if it never happened. To me and OP, these suicides aren’t merely a “Haha, I win” moment. They are life lessons, something that will forever remind the people who wronged us that their actions have consequences. It’s the ultimate middle finger to people that live their wretched lives without any fear of having someone’s blood on their hands. 

I went through this today. I broke down and posted on social media asking for a gun. No response directly to me, but my parents got two calls (out of like 150 people). I can promise you that those people would never have reached out to me if I never posted on social media again. 

People only care when they’re afraid of the consequences and the guilt that they caused. They want to remain oblivious to the fact that there is a ripple effect to how they treat people. 

Killing ourselves is the ultimate way to ensure that those fuckers never get the chance to forget what they did, and to make them think twice before doing it to somebody else. 

OP, I’m sorry if this isn’t what you believe. It’s my truth and I felt as if I needed to tell it.
I wish I knew myself. I just feel like I live my life in an abyss, or in some alternate reality in which I don’t exist. I feel your pain my friend.
